notes: Static preflight retains its basic-syntax warning; R parse(file=...) passed.
Static width recognition warned; source configures 183 mm width. No journal-specific size contract was requested.

single_panel_alignment.notes: F07 is one ggplot panel; there is no between-panel alignment comparison.

png_visual_review.findings: The final PNG was inspected at full resolution. Chinese text, group labels, bar counts, zero-execution markers, and the wrapped caption are legible without visible clipping or overlap.

pdf_text_audit.notes: The generic audit reports Cairo PDF text at 1 pt; PyMuPDF text spans report 8.5–15 pt. Cairo's text matrix and CJK subset extraction are not represented reliably by the generic scanner, so this remains review-only rather than an automatic pass.

pdf_collision_audit.notes: The scanner flags Cairo text-trace boxes crossing bar edges and overlapping neighboring ticks. Full-resolution PNG inspection shows no corresponding visual collision; retain the PDF findings unresolved pending a Cairo-aware checker.

limitations: The source cases are constructed developer fixtures, not human or teacher-labeled data.
No external Provider inference or model charge occurred.
